name: vent
note: Roof vent / stair-bulkhead louvre box. The louvre is ZONE-ONLY: a single thin plate in the `louvre` zone on the +Z face, never a repeat of slats. Per-slat geometry at this scale is sub-pixel at the frozen 900 px capture (V5 would collapse it anyway) and would cost ~8 tris a slat for nothing.
